I'll be calling on each of you individually -- identity platform lead, IT operations lead, and compliance engineer -- to state any rollout-impacting findings, the exact plan changes you require, and the follow-up you'll own. I won't approve the plan until each role has completed that check-in. Let's start with identity platform -- what findings do you have?
